title: One Picture Book Two Vol 53: Correspondences

description.main: Sixteen duotone photographs of gestures and architectural details from Albania, drawn from Camilla de Maffei's archive of travel in the country between 2018 and 2023.
description.extended:
Sixteen duotone photographs of gestures and architectural details from Albania, drawn from the archive Camilla de Maffei built over five years of travel in the country.

De Maffei travelled through Albania between 2018 and 2023. The country spent 1945 to 1991 in near-total isolation under one of the most repressive regimes in recent European history. Correspondences sets pictures from those journeys beside one another to bring out visual echoes between bodies and buildings, and it previews a larger body of work still in progress. It is number 53 in Nazraeli Press's One Picture Book Two series, made in collaboration with Micamera in an edition of 500 numbered copies, each with a signed 5x7 inch print.

De Maffei (b. 1981, Italy) is a photographer and educator who has worked on the Balkan Peninsula since 2009, combining photographs with ethnographic writing on territory, memory, and the aftermath of conflict. Her photobook Delta (Ediciones Anómalas, 2021) was shortlisted for the Prix du Livre at Les Rencontres d'Arles in 2023.

notes: One Picture Book Two series #53. 16 duotone plates. Made in collaboration with Micamera. Includes a 5x7 inch original print signed by the artist. The artist's former domain camillademaffei.com now redirects to an unrelated site, so no artist link is recorded.
